llm.summary: The skill is a plausible Etsy category lookup tool, but it also asks agents to install a separate remote onboarding skill and has under-scoped credential, storage, and fallback behavior that users should review first.

dimensions.detail: The core function matches the stated purpose: it searches Etsy category data by keyword and calls a LinkFox gateway with a user-provided API key. The network/API-key behavior is expected for this integration, but the destination can be changed by environment variable.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger language is broad but still Etsy-category related; the larger concern is that the skill tells the agent to install a separate remote onboarding skill when auth or quota handling is needed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md gives a direct release.zip URL for another skill and instructs installation if missing, without visible integrity checks, publisher verification, or a manual review step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The script sends the API key in an Authorization header to the configured gateway, and the gateway host is controlled by LINKFOX_TOOL_GATEWAY. That is useful for configuration but risky if the environment is untrusted or accidentally set.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The script writes full API responses, cache files, session metadata, and index records locally by default. The script documentation says /tmp is forbidden, but the implementation can fall back to the system temp directory or home directory when preferred paths are unavailable.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust LinkFox and are comfortable with this skill using your LinkFox API key, writing lookup results to local linkfox folders, and potentially guiding the agent to install a separate onboarding skill from a remote ZIP. Review or constrain LINKFOX_TOOL_GATEWAY, avoid running it in sensitive workspaces, and prefer manual approval before any additional skill installation.
llm.findings:
[TT3] expected: Outbound API calls with an API key are expected for this tool, but the unvalidated gateway override makes credential forwarding dependent on the runtime environment.
[SDI-1] expected: Persisting responses is disclosed in the script comments, but always writing full responses plus cache and metadata is broader than a simple lookup needs.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The artifact text says not to write to /tmp, while the code includes a temp-directory fallback; this is a real documentation/behavior mismatch.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger is broad, but it remains centered on Etsy category lookup rather than an unrelated capability.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Installing another remote skill for onboarding is not necessary to perform category search and crosses a separate trust boundary.
